calendar.matters:
NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Aug-15-2019 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 514. Judge: Gail Dekreon. Clerk: K. Dougherty. Proceedings Not Reported.

Petitioner Eunice Seyoung Chang, a/k/a Euice Chang, was present in pro per.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Eunice Chang Likas.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

NAME CHANGE CALENDAR
Off Calendar Jun-27-2019 Reset To Aug-15-19 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 514 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 514. Judge: Newton Lam. Clerk: K. Dougherty. Proceedings Not Reported.

Petitioner Eunice Seyong Chang was present in pro per.
No Proof of Publication in the file.

Good cause appearing, the matter is CONTINUED to August 15, 2019 for further proceedings. The Court shall prepare the Amended Order to Show Cause for Change of Name, and submit same to the Daily Journal for publication.
